decisions.reason: Defining visual object type 2 does not change the required number of reviewable questions or the question-review sequence.
The visual representation assigned to an object type does not alter the rules for gradual progression or curriculum-block-based level splitting.
Specifying a box containing a number as an object type does not change how questions are copied into applicable levels.
The object-type specification neither changes curriculum coverage nor resolves the existing uncertainty about Grade 5 topics.
The visual object-type definition does not change the deferred C# random-generator requirement, its constraints, or its execution environment.
